field_scope.excluded_overstatement: No all-characteristic-not-two claim is made.  In characteristic 3 the coefficient -3 and the displayed node discriminants degenerate.

inverse_level.positive_result: Every algebraic equation is forced by one of two raw contraction branches, and the exact same marked finite-volume noncompact H10/30 chamber returns.
inverse_level.why_not_L4: This is one rigid raw polytope and one known abstract chamber, not a variable P-only class with an exhaustive necessary-and-sufficient carrier theorem.

lineage.abstract_polytope: the already known D16-D5 H10/30 chamber
lineage.distinct_nearby_models: Kondo Example 4.5 uses a P1xP1 double-cover quotient.  The Hessian Coble surfaces of Allcock-Dolgachev are a different tetrahedral family with infinite automorphism group and ten proper nodes.
lineage.new_project_content: the strict raw-P derivation of the 7+3 cluster and its identification as the Choi-Lam sextic, followed by an exact strong-Coble and same-H10/30 return; no known Type-II surface equation is imported
lineage.priority_boundary: new exact realization and cross-identification in this project; no worldwide priority claim for the Choi-Lam/Coble link, no new equation, no new abstract polytope, no new dimension, and not L4
lineage.sextic_equation_lineage: The forced equation is the Choi-Lam cyclic extremal positive-semidefinite ternary sextic from 1977; the polynomial itself is not new.

root_boundary_disjointness.geometric: The boundary is absolutely irreducible of degree six and hence contains no root line; all strict curves are distinct effective irreducibles on the smooth blowup. Nonnegative local intersection plus total intersection zero makes every root disjoint from the strict boundary.
root_boundary_disjointness.numerical: B.C=(-2K).C=0 for every one of the twelve roots
root_boundary_disjointness.root_root_transversality: Six line pairs meet at unblown ordinary double intersections; each of the three exceptional roots meets the three nonselected tangent directions over its parent. These fifteen intersections are transverse and every other root pair is disjoint.

same_polytope_return.general_theorem_handoff: The twelve explicitly constructed roots are the complete raw CM root seed. D_CobVin gives finite volume and finite reflection index; Kondo root exhaustion excludes hidden roots; the one-boundary Halphen cusp theorem realizes exactly the seventeen raw E=f-b walls and excludes every hidden (-1)-curve.
